query: What is one major duty of the Chief AI Officer (CAIO)?
response:

Part 2: This duty is explicitly assigned to the CAIO by Executive Order 14110, as noted in the documentation of enterprise-level roles. The role is central to recent federal mandates aimed at improving AI governance and innovation within government agencies. These responsibilities include overseeing the implementation of agency-specific AI governance plans and ensuring compliance with broader directives to advance trustworthy AI development and use.
ground_truth: Maintain awareness of all AI activities and how systems work within GSA.
